snippet.title: Cozy Holiday – Announcement Trailer (Coming VERY SOON!!)
snippet.description:
Hello Guys. 

In the middle of our fast-paced everyday work, we paused to build something softer — Cozy Holiday, a relaxing co-op game for two players. Discover winter wonderlands, deliver gifts, and enjoy the moments with your friends. 
We hope you’ll like our new game and enjoy your time with it.

Wishlist us here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134110/Cozy_Holiday/   

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/VQqrmTAh4n  

#cozygames  #coop #coopgames #cooperation #videogames #friendslop
